description: FRONTAGE COMMUNAL GARDEN:T1 Flowering Cherry: FELL TO GROUND LEVEL and remove stump.COMMUNAL GARDEN:T2 Norway Maple: REDUCE approximately 8m lateral branches on the building and fire escape side by 2m.T3 Norway Maple: REDUCE approximately 8m lateral branches and branches touching the building by up to 2m.T4 Walnut: REDUCE all branches on the building side by 2m to provide approximately 2m clearance from the building.Council Note:On 21 September 2026 Lambeth Council made provisional Tree Preservation Order TPO No. 540. The Order protects only the five individually identified trees on the Kennington Lane frontage: T1 Flowering Cherry, T2 Cherry, T3 multi-stem Birch, T4 Cherry and T5 Cherry. It does not extend to other trees within the Tamar House grounds or to shrubs. The Order takes effect immediately and remains provisional for up to six months unless confirmed by the Council, whichever occurs first. For a copy of the provisional TPO, or to make representations, please email planningconservation@lambeth.gov.uk.
